'''Lazy Teen''' is an NPC located in [[Tower of Adversity]], [[Central Plains]]. He is friends with a [[Hoartoise|turtle]] [[Tacet Discord|tacet discord]] named Slowly.

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Lazy Teen}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Lazy Teen)
:'''Lazy Teen:''' Oh hey! Didn't even see you coming. I was too caught up in watching Slowly.
:'''Lazy Teen:''' One step, two steps... Slowly, slowly...
:{{DIcon}} Slowly?
:'''Lazy Teen:''' Yeah, see this little turtle right next to me? That's Slowly. Been my companion for quite a while.
:'''Lazy Teen:''' Just strolling along, nice and slow...
:'''Lazy Teen:''' I'm here, just chilling and watching Slowly, while it's here, taking in the scenery. We're always together, but we don't bother each other.
:'''Lazy Teen:''' I don't get why it doesn't give me any trouble. Maybe we just get along pretty well...?
:'''Lazy Teen:''' But, you know, watch out for the other turtles around here. They're not as friendly as Slowly
{{Dialogue End}}
